title: REQ · App shows the intro screen before gameplay
summary: App renders IntroScreen until the player clicks Begin
description: Context: IntroScreen takes an onBegin prop and main.tsx needs a default-exported App. Desired behavior: App keeps a begun flag, false at start; while false it renders only IntroScreen. Expected result: the player sees the intro copy first and the entry point compiles. Why: the opening experience begins with the boy's question.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh App render, then the text 'What should I do?' and a Begin button are visible
Given a fresh App render, then no hotspot buttons are rendered
technical_constraints: useState for the begun flag; no new dependencies
definition_of_done: App.tsx default-exports a component that renders IntroScreen first
